book.name: Ioanes
book.title: Bais ula mumuru la omirong Ioanes aime Iesu

content: Tie, Iesu la inagat tiesong me lop o usingnualap gare ro, “Baraba giginam dalap mi ga agatming papot. Naganming ira Morowa ga naganming gat ira ruo.
Na luguan ang Mamo ruang ame papot ma kabilip. La karuk, tie eba tale miralava. Eba rala ga eba orangarang pianam ming.
Ga leba rala orangarang pianam ming, tie eba ina terigirang ga milagirang me toi, meba gat mimi ba le mionang na urie pianam la tunama una.
Omit ara uriro alang la ila na pianam la tunama una.”
Iesu irie alang maiang teip ga magaulap me ai Mamo
Tie, Tomas la aulo Iesu, “Ila Kakani, tale kan opet eba nala lagum. Are mani ga puovang meba opera uriro alang? Tale kan puovang.”
Iesu la upulo uriro umarik gare ro, “Turuo kan alang, ga turuo muana o ties migat, ga turuo muana o ninimiap. Karuk kan a noba migana leba muong ai Mamo na noba alang. Karuk. Ira ruot.
La tomit ara migat, tie puoming meba amira Mamo ruang gat. Titot pumiaro la amit ara ga agimaming ara.”
Filip la ugama aime Iesu, “Ila Kakani, pasingnala a Mamo nuang ga eba puoieng ira pa.”
Iesu la aulo, “Filip, laklager a tara la tunama ga mimi. Pa tale ka tomit turuo aga, a? Migana la togimaong, agimaong ara Mamo ruang gat. Tie, are mani ga nugama, ‘pasingnala a Mamo nuang?’

Atabo tale kan nagannung la tunama ira Mamo ruang, pa unama Mamo ruang ira ruo? Tiesiap la tualam miun, mirie la tale kan makosartung o agat kan tung. Mamo la unama ira ruo, irie la ume makosar ubiap am kan.
Oagatming ara uriro ties: Tunama ira Mamo ruang, pa Mamo ruang la unama ira ruo. La karuk, tie naganming irama mirier ubiap la makosartung ga naganming ira ruo me miriro ubiap.
Mirulo migat: Man migana la naganong ira ruo, eba gat makosarang mirie ubiap la tume makosartung. Eva, eba makosarang ubiap mila kakanim maset me mirie la makosartung. Memani, eba rala ai Mamo ruang.
Ga eba makosartang mirier pagap ganam la amarikming Morowa Mamo na bonim tuo. Are ratmat ga eba arang Mamo bonim ula kakanu ira ruo Poi ang.
Eva, mirier pagap leba mamarikming na bonim tuo, eba makosartang.”
Iesu la ugama eba asagaang Muranama Ila Babai ga muong
Tie, Iesu la tiesong gare ro, “Leba naming migat me rulam, tie eba maset mamiuluan maimaiap tuam la tualam miun.
Ga eba amariktang Mamo meba alang miun non ara aganuliap meba miagaalie ga mingangasang. Ga eba man onang ga mimi mar mirie lap ganam.

Iriro la muranama o ties migat. Teip ga magaulap onim na kimanam la tale puomeng meba amela. Memani, tale kan agimameng ga tale ameit. Pa mimi la amit. Memani, irie la unama ga mimi ga eba onang tapma na dalap mi.
Tale kan puorung meba mirolaing ga mirairang meba mionang agarit. Gare ba lop la tale memaning irap ga nagap. Karuk. Eba ina terigirang me mi.

Tubiat it teip ga magaulap onim na kimanam la tale kan puomeng meba ina togimameng gat. Pa mimi la eba togimaming. Memani, eba ina terara na nuvarap ga temung. Ga mimi gat leba ina temiara na nuvarap ga mimung.
Na uriro la Muranama Ila Babai leba muong mi, ga eba mira, tunama ai Mamo ruang ga mionama ira ruo pa tunama ira mi.

Man migana la oula maimai rung ga ouluan maset, iriro migana la naong maset me rulam. Ga man migana la naong me rulam, Mamo ruang leba onang gat ai. Ga turuo gat leba narang aime, ga eba tevaiktang kan ai.”
Iudas tale onim Iskariot la ugama aime, “Pa Ila Kakani, are mani ga eba tevaiknang na irap pa, pa tale iga tevaiknang na irap ma teip ga magaulap onim na kimanam?”
Iesu la aulo Iudas gare ro, “Migana la naong me rulam migat, eba maset oauluo ties tung. Ga eba naang Mamo ruang aime, eba muiong ai. Ga ira ruang ga turuo la eba ionang ira a.
Migana la tale maset naong me rulam, eba tale ouluan maset ties tung. Uriro ties la mipto, tale ties tung kan. Karuk. Ties ang Mamo irie la tosagaong ga muruo na uro kimanam.”
“Tara la tunama ka ga mimi, mirulo ma mirio pagap.

Pa aganuliap ming migat meba mingangasang, irie Muranama Ila Babai. Eba asagaang Mamo ga muong na bonim tuo. Eba betang ga misingala ma mirier pagap ganam. Ga are gat to eba mavavarangas ang agarip mim ga eba ina magatming mirier tiesiap ganam la tualam miun.

Tuga mirolaing, mivuorung a malina; tuala malina tuang miun; tale kan migamti gare teip ga magaulap onim na uro kimanam la mime dakamai. Are ratmat ga baraba giginam dalap mi ga agatming papot, ga baraba mirau.
Mipto ra uriro ties la tualo miun: Eba mirolaing ga tala ga eba ina murang mi. Leba naming migat me rulam, temiba togo leba rala ai Mamo. Memani, Mamo la kakani migat me rulam.
Iriro paga la tale ka betong pa titot la mirulo ra. Memani, tubiat tara leba agimaming iriro la eba betang, eba naganming turuo Karisito.
Tala gat tiestung papot ga mimi. Memani, iriro migana ila uke la uale bo urogo kimanam la namor muong titot. Tale kan amaning kukunim meba akosarang paga ba ira ruo.
Pa narung me teip ga magaulap onim na uro kimanam le ameira, mitara narung me Mamo ga makosartung it mirier pagap ganam gare Mamo la toulo. Tebuara ga obulaing uriro pianam ga bula.”
